summary: The W4A16 A4 prefill can be chosen per call instead of by call size
compatibility: Callers that do not choose keep the B12X_W4A16_A4_PREFILL_MIN_TOKENS threshold.
details: bind(..., a4_prefill=True) takes the NVFP4-activation prefill for any call within the prepared capacity and a4_prefill=False keeps a call on W4A16, so an integration can run prefill rows A4 and decode rows W4A16 whatever their count. Weights without calibrated activation scales stay W4A16.
